subject.title: Clarify or preserve skill source provenance from CLI publish

question: What permanent contract should `clawhub skill publish --source-repo --source-commit` provide while preserving the distinction between publisher claims and server-verified provenance?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the current safe boundary but cannot determine whether maintainers intend these flags for future verified publishing, untrusted attribution, or deprecation; each choice changes public API and UI semantics.

options.title: Document and deprecate
options.body: Clarify that the flags do not create visible or trusted provenance and deprecate them unless a verified workflow adopts them.

options.title: Expose unverified attribution
options.body: Persist and display the publisher-declared repository separately from provenance with explicit unverified labeling in every API and UI surface.

options.title: Verify CLI source
options.body: Resolve and compare the claimed GitHub commit and path server-side before storing trusted provenance for the uploaded version.

recommendation.title: Document and deprecate
recommendation.body: Clarify that the flags do not create visible or trusted provenance and deprecate them unless a verified workflow adopts them.

likelyOwner.reason: The related source-sync proposal provides the strongest available product and implementation history for this exact decision.
